name: workbench-vision
description: A lightweight macOS visual AI assistant. Hold an object to your webcam, capture one frame, and ask GPT-4o questions grounded in what it sees.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac && bash scripts/sign-mac-app.sh

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Workbench Vision uses your camera so you can capture a single frame of a physical object to analyze. The live feed stays on your device; nothing is sent until you press Analyze Object.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Workbench Vision pastes scanned photos and labels into the app you are typing in, such as ChatGPT or a browser.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Workbench Vision uses Accessibility to paste scanned photos and labels into the text field you are typing in.
